about: The scenarios page, /scenarios/, as one Task Object (the AgoraScenarios board, November 1, 2026). Its 'facts' are copied, value for value, from the scenario record of October 31, evidence/sira-are-cascade-2026-10-31/scenario_matrix_1000_digest.json in the repository, which the meta-are-scenario-matrix seed pack writes: the mode, the seed, the scenario counts and the results for each rule, stakeholder and kind of work, and three sample scenarios. Titles are in the owner's plain words, and nothing that names a compute tier is copied. Every number on the page comes from these facts; the words for each reason, stakeholder, sector and outcome are here too, and a fact without words stops the build. The mode local_verified is reported as a local check, in present tense.
title: 1,000 test scenarios | Agora
description: 1,000 test scenarios, checked by written rules with no model calls: which were approved as asked, which after a private and public split, which were blocked and why. Every number comes from the run's record.
heading: {total} test scenarios, checked against the same rules
lead: We generated situations, methods, people and stakeholders, and checked each combination against written rules: files that must stay local, a second, different checker, and time limits. Nothing here is a real request, and no model was called. Anyone can run it again from the seed.

mode.local_verified: These are local checks: the rules run on one computer, and no service or model is called.
